Script 1 · “Practice vs game day”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Why do so many high achievers play their best when nothing is on the line?”

Body

“It’s rarely a skill problem. When the stakes go up, your attention moves from the task to the outcome. I saw it in college and in the NFL, and I see it with leaders now. The fix is a routine that brings your focus back to the next job, every single time.”

CTA

“I’m teaching that routine live in a 60-minute masterclass. It’s $17 and the replay is included. Tap Sign up to grab your seat.”

Shot: talking to camera, simple background, on-screen text “practice vs game day”.

Script 2 · “The next play”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“One mistake shouldn’t cost you the next three.”

Body

“On the field we had a rule: next play. Your last rep is done, and replaying it in your head only steals focus from this one. The same is true in a pitch, a meeting or a big game. A reset is a skill, and it can be trained.”

CTA

“In The Pressure-Proof Mind I’ll show you how to reset in real time. Live, 60 minutes, $17. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera, cut to on-screen text “next play” in teal.

Script 3 · “Lead within”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“You can’t lead others well if the voice in your head is your biggest critic.”

Body

“Most high achievers coach their team better than they coach themselves. Lead within means talking to yourself the way a great coach would: clear, honest and focused on the next step. Influence beyond is what happens when you do.”

CTA

“I’ll walk you through it in my live masterclass. Seats are $17. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: talking to camera, cut to slide with “Lead within. Influence beyond.”
